title: Until lane
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：until　|　正文 355 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 until 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the musician kept the score ① until the end of the rains at the piano, and everybody in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning: the score had been left ② until the far end of the lane, and nobody had asked a single question. The musician had come to the hall two nights earlier and spoke little of the hall he had left behind him.

The programme for December 1962 puts it plainer. It was done ③ until the hour of supper, and the listener who kept the score had played it ④ until the return of his brother twice before the winter came; nothing in the hall was ever done until the hour of supper in those days. The listener wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every night thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ until the want of light, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ until the coming of the doctor; he was not a man who explained himself, and the hall had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1975 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was that the score be played ⑦ until the last day of the month, and that the names be written ⑧ until the hour of the meeting. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried until the last day of the month.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1978 she kept the score ⑨ until the end of the rains again when nobody else would, and ⑩ until the far end of the lane, she said in 1980, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the score in the same piano for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the hall never forgot what had been done until the far end of the lane.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 直到…为止（表时间：until the end of the rains）
B. prep. 直到…为止（表处所：until the far end of the lane）
C. prep. 直到…为止（表方式／状态：until the hour of supper）
D. prep. 直到…为止（引出施动者或相关的人：be played until the return of his brother）
E. prep. 直到…为止（表原因：until the want of light）
F. prep. 直到…为止（表对象／目的：until the coming of the doctor）
G. prep. 直到…为止（表工具／材料：until the last day of the month）
H. prep. 直到…为止（表载体／处所：written until the hour of the meeting）

items.q: until the end of the rains
until the far end of the lane
until the return of his brother
until the coming of the doctor
until the last day of the month
until the hour of the meeting
until the end of the rains again
until the far end of the lane, she said

answers.why: until 意为“直到…为止”，此处引出时间 the end of the rains（雨季结束），说明那件薄薄的乐谱是在何时留下的。
until 意为“直到…为止”，此处引出处所 the far end of the lane（巷子的尽头），说明东西被放在何处。
until 意为“直到…为止”，此处引出方式或状态 the hour of supper（吃晚饭的时辰），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
until 意为“直到…为止”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 他兄弟回来：be played until the return of his brother。
until 意为“直到…为止”，此处引出原因 the want of light（因为没有光），说明整件事由何而起。
until 意为“直到…为止”，此处引出对象或目的 the coming of the doctor（大夫到来之前）。
until 意为“直到…为止”，此处引出工具或材料 the last day of the month（那月的最后一天）。
until 意为“直到…为止”，此处引出载体 the hour of the meeting（开会的时辰）：names written until the hour of the meeting。
until 意为“直到…为止”，1978 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件薄薄的乐谱，此处仍引出时间 the end of the rains。
until 意为“直到…为止”，母亲 1980 年那句话引出的仍是那一处巷子的尽头。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年雨季结束前后，乐师把那件薄薄的乐谱留在了琴凳。（until the end of the rains）
那件薄薄的乐谱被放在巷子的尽头，谁也没有过问。（until the far end of the lane）
整件事是吃晚饭的时辰做成的，节目单上写得明白。（until the hour of supper）
入冬之前，那件薄薄的乐谱已经由他兄弟回来弹过两回。（be played until the return of his brother）
叔叔说，整件事是由因为没有光起的。（until the want of light）
他说，家里从来没有人为大夫到来之前做过这件事。（until the coming of the doctor）
answers: In 1968 the musician kept the score until the end of the rains at the piano.
The score had been left until the far end of the lane, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done until the hour of supper, or so the programme says.
The score had been played until the return of his brother twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun until the want of light.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it until the coming of the doctor.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 until 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the musician kept the score until the end of the rains, and nobody forgot it.
The score had been left until the far end of the lane for three nights.
The work was done until the hour of supper, as it always was in those days.
The score had been played until the return of his brother twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the score until the end of the rains again when nobody else would.
The whole hall never forgot what had been done until the far end of the lane.
